title: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Master core computer science algorithms, problem solving patterns, data structures, and tech interview preparation.

nodes.title: Foundations & Time Complexity
nodes.description: Asymptotic analysis, Big-O notation, space complexity, and math primitives for algorithm design.

children.title: Big-O Notation & Time Complexity
children.description: Analyzing best, average, and worst-case time bounds for algorithms.

children.title: Space Complexity & Memory Allocation
children.description: Auxiliary memory usage, call stack overhead, and memory efficiency.

children.title: Math & Bit Manipulation
children.description: Bitwise AND, OR, XOR, shifts, GCD, prime testing, and modular arithmetic.

nodes.title: Arrays, Hashing & String Manipulation
nodes.description: Contiguous array storage, hash table collisions, sliding window technique, and two-pointer strategies.

children.title: Array Operations & Memory Layout
children.description: Static arrays, dynamic array resizing, in-place rotation, and prefix sums.

children.title: Hash Tables & Hash Maps
children.description: Hash functions, collision resolution (chaining vs open addressing), constant time lookups.

children.title: Two Pointers Technique
children.description: Converging and same-direction two pointer patterns for array/string traversal.

children.title: Sliding Window Pattern
children.description: Fixed and dynamic sliding window algorithms for subarray/substring optimization.

nodes.title: Stacks, Queues & Linked Lists
nodes.description: Linear data structures, pointer manipulation, LIFO and FIFO execution pipelines.

children.title: Singly & Doubly Linked Lists
children.description: Node pointers, insertion, deletion, cycle detection (Floyd's algorithm), and reversing lists.

children.title: Stack & Monotonic Stack
children.description: LIFO push/pop, expression evaluation, matching parentheses, and next greater element.

children.title: Queue & Monotonic Queue
children.description: FIFO enqueue/dequeue, circular queues, sliding window maximum with monotonic queue.

nodes.title: Trees & Binary Search Trees (BST)
nodes.description: Hierarchical tree traversals, BST properties, balanced trees, and lowest common ancestor algorithms.

children.title: Binary Tree Traversals (DFS & BFS)
children.description: In-order, Pre-order, Post-order DFS traversals, and Level-order BFS traversal.

children.title: Binary Search Tree Properties
children.description: BST search, insertion, deletion, validation, and k-th smallest element finding.

children.title: Trie (Prefix Tree)
children.description: Prefix tree insertion, search, prefix matching, and autocomplete algorithms.

nodes.title: Heaps & Priority Queues
nodes.description: Binary heap mechanics, heapify algorithms, top-K element extraction, and median finding.

children.title: Min-Heap & Max-Heap Implementation
children.description: Array representation of complete binary trees, percolate up/down operations.

children.title: Top-K Frequent Elements & K-th Largest
children.description: Using min-heap of size K for optimal O(N log K) element tracking.

nodes.title: Graphs & Network Algorithms
nodes.description: Graph representations, BFS/DFS explorations, shortest paths, topological sorting, and union-find.

children.title: Graph Representations & BFS/DFS
children.description: Adjacency matrix vs adjacency list, graph traversal algorithms, connected components.

children.title: Topological Sort & Cycle Detection
children.description: Kahn's algorithm (BFS degree counting) and DFS cycle detection in directed graphs.

children.title: Shortest Path (Dijkstra & Bellman-Ford)
children.description: Weighted graph shortest path algorithms with priority queue optimization.

children.title: Disjoint Set Union (DSU / Union-Find)
children.description: Path compression, rank-based union, Kruskal's minimum spanning tree algorithm.

nodes.title: Dynamic Programming (DP)
nodes.description: Overlapping subproblems, optimal substructure, Memoization (Top-Down) vs Tabulation (Bottom-Up).

children.title: 1D Dynamic Programming
children.description: Climbing stairs, house robber, coin change, longest increasing subsequence.

children.title: 2D & Grid Dynamic Programming
children.description: Unique paths, minimum path sum, 0/1 Knapsack, Edit Distance, LCS.
